boundary.description: From the junction of Rocky Lane and Chorlton Fold, E along Folly Brook to the border of Eccles College then by a beeline SW to Ellesmere Road (Godolphin Close and Welbeck Road both in Ss Peter and Paul parish). SW along Ellesmere Road, E along Victoria Crescent, Half Edge Lane, Eccles Old Road, Stott Lane to its junction with Eccles New Road. Then by a beeline SW to the roundabout joining Coronet Way and Centenary Way, S along Centenary Way and W by Manchester Ship Canal. Then W by the canal to the point and by a beeline to and along SW border of Boysnope Park Golf Club and by a footpath crossing Raspberry Lane and Twelve Yards Road to the railway. W along the railway and N by a Wigan – Salford District boundary to Bridgewater Canal. Then E by the Canal and Bridgewater Way to its confluence with Folly Brook to the junction of Rocky Lane and Chorlton Fold.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Holy Cross, St Matthew and St Gilbert with St Mary
internalBoundaries.description: From the Manchester Ship Canal opposite Ashbourne Road and NW by a beeline to the junction of Ashbourne Road and Barton Lane, and W along Barton Lane. N along Fairless Road, Trafford Road, Renshae Avenue, Mellor Street, Liverpool Road, Green Lane, Canal Bank, Bridgewater Way and by a beeline to Folly Brook.
